rooms.title: First hellos
rooms.intro_en: Let's practice simple hellos. Short answers are fine!

turns.ask_en: Hello! How are you?
turns.model_en: I'm fine, thank you. And you?
turns.model_es: Estoy bien, gracias. ¿Y tú?

turns.ask_en: What's your name?
turns.model_en: My name is Carlos.
turns.model_es: Me llamo Carlos.

turns.ask_en: Where are you from?
turns.model_en: I'm from Mexico.
turns.model_es: Soy de México.

turns.ask_en: Nice to meet you! Do you speak English?
turns.model_en: A little. I am learning.
turns.model_es: Un poco. Estoy aprendiendo.

turns.ask_en: See you later! Have a nice day.
turns.model_en: Thank you! You too. Goodbye!
turns.model_es: ¡Gracias! Igualmente. ¡Adiós!

rooms.title: Simple questions
rooms.intro_en: Easy questions to warm up. Answer in short sentences.

turns.ask_en: Do you work or study?
turns.model_en: I work in an office.
turns.model_es: Trabajo en una oficina.

turns.ask_en: What do you like?
turns.model_en: I like music and coffee.
turns.model_es: Me gusta la música y el café.

turns.ask_en: How is the weather today?
turns.model_en: It is sunny and warm.
turns.model_es: Está soleado y templado.

turns.ask_en: What time is it?
turns.model_en: It is three o'clock.
turns.model_es: Son las tres en punto.

turns.ask_en: Are you happy today?
turns.model_en: Yes, I am happy. Thank you!
turns.model_es: Sí, estoy feliz. ¡Gracias!

rooms.title: Small talk warm-up
rooms.intro_en: Let's warm up with quick small talk. Answer fast, out loud. Don't overthink!

turns.ask_en: Hi! How are you doing today?
turns.model_en: I'm doing great, thanks! How about you?
turns.model_es: Estoy muy bien, ¡gracias! ¿Y tú?

turns.ask_en: How was your weekend?
turns.model_en: It was relaxing. I spent time with my family.
turns.model_es: Fue relajante. Pasé tiempo con mi familia.

turns.ask_en: The weather is crazy, right? What's it like where you are?
turns.model_en: Yes! It's quite hot and sunny here today.
turns.model_es: ¡Sí! Aquí hoy hace bastante calor y sol.

turns.ask_en: Have you had a busy week?
turns.model_en: Pretty busy, actually. I've had a lot of meetings.
turns.model_es: Bastante ocupada, la verdad. He tenido muchas reuniones.

turns.ask_en: Nice chatting with you! Any plans later?
turns.model_en: Thanks! Later I'm going to relax and maybe cook dinner.
turns.model_es: ¡Gracias! Más tarde voy a relajarme y quizás cocinar la cena.

rooms.title: Daily standup
rooms.intro_en: You're in your team's daily standup. I'll ask, you speak. Ready?

turns.ask_en: Good morning! What did you work on yesterday?
turns.model_en: Yesterday I worked on the report and fixed two small issues.
turns.model_es: Ayer trabajé en el informe y arreglé dos problemas pequeños.

turns.ask_en: Great. What are you focusing on today?
turns.model_en: Today I'm going to finish the presentation and review the results.
turns.model_es: Hoy voy a terminar la presentación y revisar los resultados.

turns.ask_en: Any blockers I can help you with?
turns.model_en: Yes, I'm waiting for access to the database. Could you help me with that?
turns.model_es: Sí, estoy esperando acceso a la base de datos. ¿Podrías ayudarme con eso?

turns.ask_en: Sure, I'll sort it out. Is the deadline still realistic?
turns.model_en: I think so, as long as I get the access today.
turns.model_es: Creo que sí, siempre que consiga el acceso hoy.

turns.ask_en: Perfect. Anything else for the team?
turns.model_en: No, that's all from me. Thanks, everyone.
turns.model_es: No, eso es todo de mi parte. Gracias a todos.

rooms.title: Call with a partner
rooms.intro_en: You're on a call with an international partner. Speak clearly and confidently.

turns.ask_en: Thanks for joining. Could you introduce yourself and your role?
turns.model_en: Of course. My name is Carlos and I'm responsible for the operations team.
turns.model_es: Por supuesto. Me llamo Carlos y soy responsable del equipo de operaciones.

turns.ask_en: Great to meet you. Can you give us a quick update on the project?
turns.model_en: Sure. We're on track. We finished the first phase and we're starting the second.
turns.model_es: Claro. Vamos según lo previsto. Terminamos la primera fase y empezamos la segunda.

turns.ask_en: Sorry, could you clarify what you mean by the second phase?
turns.model_en: Yes, of course. By the second phase I mean testing the product with real users.
turns.model_es: Sí, claro. Con la segunda fase me refiero a probar el producto con usuarios reales.

turns.ask_en: What do you think is the biggest risk right now?
turns.model_en: In my opinion, the biggest risk is the tight timeline, but we're managing it.
turns.model_es: En mi opinión, el mayor riesgo es el plazo ajustado, pero lo estamos gestionando.

turns.ask_en: Understood. What do you need from our side?
turns.model_en: It would help if your team could share the data by Friday.
turns.model_es: Ayudaría si su equipo pudiera compartir los datos para el viernes.

turns.ask_en: We can do that. Let's wrap up — any final thoughts?
turns.model_en: Just to say thank you. I look forward to working with your team.
turns.model_es: Solo dar las gracias. Tengo muchas ganas de trabajar con su equipo.

rooms.title: Introduce yourself
rooms.intro_en: New people just joined the meeting. Introduce yourself naturally.

turns.ask_en: Welcome! Could you tell us a bit about yourself?
turns.model_en: Hi everyone, I'm Carlos. I work in customer operations and I've been here two years.
turns.model_es: Hola a todos, soy Carlos. Trabajo en operaciones de clientes y llevo aquí dos años.

turns.ask_en: Nice! What does your team actually do?
turns.model_en: My team handles support and makes sure our clients are happy.
turns.model_es: Mi equipo se encarga del soporte y de que nuestros clientes estén contentos.

turns.ask_en: Cool. What are you hoping to get from this meeting?
turns.model_en: I'm hoping we can agree on the next steps and clarify our roles.
turns.model_es: Espero que podamos acordar los próximos pasos y aclarar nuestros roles.

turns.ask_en: Makes sense. How do you prefer to communicate — email or calls?
turns.model_en: I prefer short calls for quick things and email for details.
turns.model_es: Prefiero llamadas cortas para cosas rápidas y correo para los detalles.

rooms.title: Give your opinion
rooms.intro_en: In meetings you must share opinions fast. Let's practice that pressure.

turns.ask_en: We need to cut the budget. What's your opinion?
turns.model_en: In my opinion, we should cut travel costs before we touch the team.
turns.model_es: En mi opinión, deberíamos recortar los gastos de viaje antes de tocar al equipo.

turns.ask_en: Some people disagree. How would you respond?
turns.model_en: I understand their concern, but I think it's the safest option for now.
turns.model_es: Entiendo su preocupación, pero creo que es la opción más segura por ahora.

turns.ask_en: Should we launch now or wait one more month?
turns.model_en: I'd rather wait a month to make sure the quality is high.
turns.model_es: Preferiría esperar un mes para asegurar que la calidad sea alta.

turns.ask_en: Interesting. Can you give one reason to support that?
turns.model_en: Sure. If we launch too early, the bugs could damage our reputation.
turns.model_es: Claro. Si lanzamos demasiado pronto, los errores podrían dañar nuestra reputación.

turns.ask_en: Good point. How do we convince the client?
turns.model_en: We should show them the data and explain the long-term benefits.
turns.model_es: Deberíamos mostrarles los datos y explicar los beneficios a largo plazo.
